name: bdims-caliper
description: Hyperledger Caliper benchmarks for the BDIMS contracts.

scripts.bench: npm run bench:manufacturers && npm run bench:pharmacies && node scripts/summarise.js
scripts.bench:manufacturers: caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace . --caliper-networkconfig networks/bdims-manufacturers.json --caliper-benchconfig benchmarks/bdims-manufacturers.yaml --caliper-flow-skip-install --caliper-report-path reports/bdims-manufacturers.html
scripts.bench:pharmacies: caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace . --caliper-networkconfig networks/bdims-pharmacies.json --caliper-benchconfig benchmarks/bdims-pharmacies.yaml --caliper-flow-skip-install --caliper-report-path reports/bdims-pharmacies.html
